data.text: Updated AGENTS.md from the installed bead prime and onboard guidance, removed the legacy br/bd/bv workflow block, and aligned docs/roadmap.md and docs/testing.md. Preserved explicit user authorization for code commits, pushes and publication. Confirmed the complete roadmap query needs --limit 0: 58 of 58 issues returned without more pages. Validation passed: git diff --check; file-budget check (zero governed source files for this documentation-only change); relative links in all three documents; no legacy workflow commands in AGENTS.md; legacy export identifier check (227 issues). Rust matrix not run because no backend or dependency changes were made. Historical .beads files and verification scripts remain unchanged; the export check does not validate live beadroll state. No application code committed or pushed.

data.reason: Migrated agent and backlog guidance to beadroll, preserved Git authorization, and verified documentation, CLI queries and legacy export validation.
